defects.claim: The issue's title rule is "cost lines only on own-key", but the receipts digest only hides cost on `platform`. It still prints `$cost` when `key_source` is `unknown`. The guard is `if exec.KeySource != memory.KeySourcePlatform {`, and `scanExecutionDetail` maps empty to unknown via `COALESCE(NULLIF(key_source, ''), 'unknown')` at internal/memory/store.go:866. The structured brief does the opposite (structured.go:78 `if run.KeySource == memory.KeySourceOwn`). This repeats the founder-tenant pitfall from project memory: that tenant records `key_source=unknown` on every execution, so its Telegram digest keeps showing per-run cost.

`formatReceiptsTotal` drops the day total only when a row is `platform`. A day mixing own and unknown rows still prints a total that includes the unknown spend. The same unknown-vs-own gap as above; no test covers `unknown` in the receipts path (structured_test.go only checks own and platform in `TestFormatReceiptLine_PlatformKeyOmitsCost`).

`SetPoolSource` has no non-test caller in the checkout. A Grep for `SetPoolSource` outside tests finds only the definition, and the brief generator is built at cmd/pilot/main.go:3992 (`generator := briefs.NewGenerator(store, briefsConfig)`) with no pool source wired. So `pool` is always null in production. This is allowed by "when the daemon knows it", but the section is never populated.

the `make lint` output shows `make: *** [Makefile:94: lint] Error 1`, from 3 staticcheck SA4023 findings in cmd/pilot/tunnel.go (package cmd/pilot). The diff doesn't touch that file, so this is a pre-existing failure, but the acceptance bullet "make lint pass" is not met.
the new `brief_payloads` table has no down path and no retention or pruning. It gets one row per daily run and grows without bound. It is SQLite, so RLS does not apply.
